Behavior:
	- Automatically equips the best gear on every level change
	- Only gathers phase 4 special-supply materials that are not the highest rank
	- The “Name of Item to Gather” setting has no effect
	- Does not attempt to gather any Clouded materials

	- Both gatherers must be Lv. 10 or higher and have the corresponding gear set for jobs to switch properly

	- If no name is specified, only gathers phase 4 special-supply materials
	- Only attempts to gather Clouded materials when a Clouded gathering point is the nearest one

OccultCrescentHelper-TreasureManager-Aut:
Automatically searches the zone for newly spawned treasure chests along a preset route.

Notes:
	- Requires this module’s “Auto Open Nearby Chests” feature to be enabled, with a distance threshold of ≤ 5 recommended; no other similar plugin feature can replace it.
	- During the search, the coordinate packets uploaded to the server are intercepted and modified, so other players will not notice.
	- After a single route is finished, automatically uses “Lesser Return” to go back to the zone’s starting point.
A value that is too large exceeds the teleport speed tolerance and may get you forcibly logged out by the server when trying to open a chest; if your network is poor, do not set it above 5

Too close to the zone’s starting point: move away, make sure no one nearby is paying attention, then click Start

ReceiveEventCommand-CommandHelp-Detailed:
Example:
	/pdr {0} Lobby 5 7
	Explanation: sends the Lobby agent an event of type 5 with the argument 7 (int type)
	Effect: enters character creation from the character selection screen

Note:
	- Agents are the systems in the game responsible for communication between windows and the actual execution logic; compared with addon callbacks, agent events can perform broader and deeper functions
	- Agent names and event arguments can be looked up and recorded in the Agent Debug tab of the /tweaks Debug window provided by the Simple Tweaks plugin
